system.details:
Use a task to moult, gaining two benefits of your choice from the following list that last until you moult with this aspect again:

  • Recurve Claw - You deal CQ Keen or Hewing damage,
  • Spined Scissor - You deal CQ Spike damage and treat Conflicts as Triumphs when restraining a target,
  • Fluting - You are immune to Keen damage,
  • Bulwark Shell - You resist Blunt and Blast damage,
  • Tetrantid - You've sculpted additional limbs, allowing you to hold more than usual,
  • Refine - Add one temporary rank to any two of your existing skills,
  • Reconstruct - Add one temporary box to any two of your aspects which are lost when burned or marked.
